title: Apply buffer to residential category post-rent
gherkin:
Given a rental property in the residential category
When a rental transaction is completed
Then a category-specific post-rent buffer is applied to the residential category

title: Different buffer amounts for different categories

title: Buffer applied only after rent is collected
gherkin:
Given a rental property with a configured post-rent buffer
When the rental transaction is pending
Then no buffer is applied
When the rental transaction is completed
Then the category-specific buffer is applied
rationale: Verifies that the post-rent buffer is only applied after the rental transaction is completed, not before.

title: Buffer does not affect rental payment to owner

And the buffer is held separately
